scope: One-Hz core0 service sensitivity; service budget is NOT a measured PHY cost.
assumptions: No initial pending timer callbacks; periodic releases on core0, fixed service budget including timer dispatch/scheduling/PHY wrapper/body.
Core0 can service timer before continuing owner work; receiver task priority policy remains to be fixed.
SPI IRQ/tick remain additive. Does not model the PHY changing RF data or extending hardware busy state.
Sampled phases and finite trace are not all-phase or WCET proofs. Zero-service case must reproduce the previous trace exactly.
